UserPreferences.title: User Preferences
UserPreferences.description: User specific favorites and customization preferences

userId.description: The unique ID of the authenticated user

favorites.description: List of user's favorite cities (maximum of 3)

notificationLocations.description: Cities the user has registered for active push notifications

notificationCategories.description: List of categories of push alert notifications (e.g., storm, agriculture, solar)

notificationEnabled.description: Whether push alerts are fully active

aiRecommendations.description: List of AI generated crop / field recommendations

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last preference update

Calibration.title: Calibration
Calibration.description: Public map calibration and weather feedback submitted by users or guests

x.description: Horizontal coordinate on the canvas map

y.description: Vertical coordinate on the canvas map

event.description: The type of weather event calibrated (e.g., Storm, Rainy, Sunny, Wind)

detail.description: Detailed description of the localized weather observation

timestamp.description: Date and time when the calibration was recorded

Report.title: User Report
Report.description: User reported errors and suggestions for the administrator

type.description: Whether this is an error report or a suggestion

message.description: Details of the error or suggestion

userEmail.description: Optional email of the reporting user

Advertisement.title: Advertisement
Advertisement.description: Custom administrator-created advertisements and sponsor content

description.description: Detailed body copy of the advertisement

linkUrl.description: URL destination when clicking the ad

CieFeedback.title: CIE User Feedback
CieFeedback.description: User ratings on forecast accuracy and AI recommendation usefulness for improving the Climate Intelligence Engine

aiRating.description: AI recommendation usefulness rating from 1 to 5

/users/{userId}.description: Document holding preferences and saved cities for a specific user

/calibrations/{calibrationId}.description: Public calibration and weather feedback points shown on the maps

/reports/{reportId}.description: Collection of user reported errors and suggestions

/ads/{adId}.description: Collection of sponsor advertisements managed by admins

/cie_feedback/{feedbackId}.description: User ratings on forecast accuracy and AI recommendation usefulness
